data.heading: AI-Native Engineering Lifecycle
data.description: We engineer the spec, agentic systems accelerate the build and production signals improve every cycle

blocks.title: Architect
blocks.body: Translate business intent into an executable architecture, data, integration, identity model, policy constraints, and security posture before anything is built
items: Every strong build starts with clarity before code. We translate business intent into an executable specification, mapping the data model, integration points, identity structure, policy constraints, security posture and operating requirements the workflow needs to function reliably in the enterprise.

That specification becomes the shared contract across business, engineering and governance teams. Everyone aligns on what is being built, how it should behave and the conditions it must satisfy before implementation begins. Governance is designed into the specification from the start, creating a clear foundation for everything that follows.

blocks.title: Build
blocks.body: Engineers harness agents to implement the spec, generating code and assembling production-ready workflows inside your environment
items: This is where the specification comes alive. As part of the Amp’d approach, Agivant uses Bolt to help engineers harness AI agents to turn the agreed spec into working code, integrations and assembled workflows within your enterprise environment and against the systems they are designed to serve.

Agents accelerate the build while engineers guide the decisions that require business context, integration judgment, quality control and edge-case handling. With a clear specification upfront and Bolt supporting the engineering process, implementation moves faster with greater consistency, while staying aligned to the intended design, controls and business outcomes.

blocks.title: Tune
blocks.body: Validate against live signals, refine design and code, lift quality and performance without rebuilding from scratch
items: A working build still needs to be tested against the realities it’s designed for. We validate workflows across business scenarios, expected outputs, integrations, performance thresholds, security controls and edge cases, then refine the design, code and agent behavior wherever needed.

The goal is to harden the solution before it operates at scale. Tune closes the gap between something that works technically and something the enterprise can confidently depend on, improving quality and readiness without repeatedly reworking the solution from the ground up.

blocks.title: Operate
blocks.body: Run in production under full observability, cost controls, and accountability loops. Reliable at load, ready to scale on demand
items: Once the solution is ready, the focus shifts to running it reliably in the enterprise. Workflows operate with observability, cost controls, security, performance monitoring and clear accountability built into the operating model from day one.

Teams have visibility into how the system is performing, how resources are being used and where attention is required. This creates the confidence to scale across users, workloads and business scenarios while keeping the solution within defined operational, governance and performance guardrails.

blocks.title: Evolve
blocks.body: Feed production learning back into the spec, turning patterns into reusable engineering assets
items: Every build creates knowledge worth carrying forward. Proven specifications, engineering patterns, reusable code, agent logic and validated components are captured so the next build can start from what has already been created and tested.

This turns individual engagements into a growing base of reusable engineering capability. New solutions can build on proven assets and patterns, helping Agivant move faster, improve consistency and bring more value into every successive build.

blocks.title: Amplify
blocks.body: Every stage ships faster, costs less, and amplifies the next. That’s what gets your enterprise Amp’d
items: Amplify is how Agivant turns every stage into greater enterprise value. Clearer specifications strengthen the build, reusable assets accelerate delivery, proven patterns improve consistency and everything created along the way gives the next build a stronger starting point.
Each gain carries forward across workflows, teams and use cases, helping enterprises move faster and get more from every AI investment. That continuous amplification of enterprise value is Amp’d.

blocks.quote: We’ve worked with Agivant across several projects, and they bring real technical depth in generative AI, LLMs and data analytics. What we value most is how they get to the core of a problem and bring strong technical thinking to the solution.

We had 18 websites to migrate to a new platform on a very tight timeline. Agivant got the right DevOps and CI/CD setup in place, completed the migration cleanly, and improved the scalability and performance of the underlying infrastructure along the way.

We needed a practical way to make sense of millions of customer call recordings. Agivant built a system that analyzes the conversations, surfaces the metrics that matter, and gives our teams insight they can actually use to improve customer interactions and operations.
Agivant put our data warehouse, data lake and BI capabilities in place before the holiday season, within a very short window. That work changed how our teams use data to make day-to-day decisions.
